title: Science PCB
intro: Physics, Chemistry and Biology after Class 10. Pick a career to see its route.

nodes.label: Choose PCB
nodes.note: Add Maths as an optional subject to keep engineering open.

nodes.label: Boards and entrance prep
nodes.note: In Karnataka this is the 2-year PUC. Board marks count for the PCB percentage rule.

nodes.label: MBBS / BDS / AYUSH
nodes.note: About 4.5 to 5.5 years including internship.

nodes.label: BVSc and AH
nodes.note: Veterinary degree through NEET merit, about 5 years.

nodes.label: BPT and allied health
nodes.note: NEET is reported to be required from 2026-27. Confirm with the institute.

nodes.label: BSc Nursing
nodes.note: 4 years. In Karnataka admission is through KCET and KEA counselling.

nodes.label: B.Pharm
nodes.note: 4 years through KCET in Karnataka.

nodes.label: BSc Life Sciences / BS-MS
nodes.note: 3 to 5 years. Research and industry route.

nodes.label: Doctor
nodes.note: Doctor, dentist, AYUSH physician. Specialise with NEET-PG after MBBS.

nodes.label: Veterinarian
nodes.note: Livestock, pets, dairy and wildlife health.

nodes.label: Physiotherapist / technologist
nodes.note: Rehabilitation, diagnostics and lab roles.

nodes.label: Nurse
nodes.note: Hospital, community and teaching roles.

nodes.label: Pharmacist
nodes.note: Hospital pharmacy, pharma industry, regulatory roles.

nodes.label: Researcher
nodes.note: Biotechnology, microbiology, genetics, teaching and PhD.

nodes.label: MD or MS (3 years)
nodes.note: Specialist training after MBBS.

nodes.label: Specialist doctor
nodes.note: Heart, bones, children, skin and many more fields.

nodes.label: BDS (dentistry, 5 years)
nodes.note: Study teeth and mouth care. Admission by NEET-UG.

nodes.label: Dentist
nodes.note: Care for teeth, gums and smiles.

nodes.label: Orthodontist
nodes.note: Straighten teeth with braces.

nodes.label: Oral surgeon
nodes.note: Do surgery on the mouth and jaw.

nodes.label: General physician
nodes.note: First doctor to see for many illnesses.

nodes.label: Government medical officer
nodes.note: Serve in government hospitals and health centres.

nodes.label: Armed forces doctor
nodes.note: Treat soldiers and families in the forces.

nodes.label: Hospital administrator
nodes.note: Run a hospital after more study.

nodes.label: Surgeon
nodes.note: Operate to treat injuries and disease.

nodes.label: Paediatrician
nodes.note: Doctor for children.

nodes.label: Cardiologist
nodes.note: Heart doctor.

nodes.label: Gynaecologist
nodes.note: Doctor for women's health and childbirth.

nodes.label: Radiologist
nodes.note: Read scans like X-ray and MRI.

nodes.label: Dermatologist
nodes.note: Skin, hair and nail doctor.

nodes.label: Psychiatrist
nodes.note: Doctor for mental health.

nodes.label: Orthopaedic surgeon
nodes.note: Bones and joints doctor.

nodes.label: Anaesthetist
nodes.note: Keeps patients safe during surgery.

nodes.label: Physiotherapist
nodes.note: Help people recover movement.

nodes.label: Optometrist
nodes.note: Test eyes and prescribe glasses.

nodes.label: Radiographer
nodes.note: Take X-rays and scans.

nodes.label: Medical lab technologist
nodes.note: Run tests that help diagnose illness.

nodes.label: Occupational therapist
nodes.note: Help people do daily tasks again.

nodes.label: Speech and hearing therapist
nodes.note: Help people speak and hear better.

nodes.label: Paramedic
nodes.note: Give emergency care on the road.

nodes.label: Dialysis technician
nodes.note: Run kidney dialysis machines.

nodes.label: Nurse practitioner
nodes.note: Advanced nurse who can do more patient care.

nodes.label: Community health nurse
nodes.note: Bring health care to villages and schools.

nodes.label: Nursing teacher
nodes.note: Train new nurses.

nodes.label: Clinical research associate
nodes.note: Run trials that test new medicines.

nodes.label: Drug inspector
nodes.note: Check medicines for safety for the government.

nodes.label: Medical representative
nodes.note: Tell doctors about new medicines.

nodes.label: Pharmaceutical scientist
nodes.note: Invent and improve medicines.

nodes.label: Biotechnologist
nodes.note: Use biology to make medicines, food and fuel.

nodes.label: Microbiologist
nodes.note: Study tiny living things like bacteria.

nodes.label: Geneticist
nodes.note: Study genes and inherited diseases.

nodes.label: Forensic scientist
nodes.note: Use science to solve crimes.

nodes.label: Food scientist
nodes.note: Make food safe and healthy.

nodes.label: Environmental scientist
nodes.note: Protect nature and fight pollution.

nodes.label: Marine biologist
nodes.note: Study life in the sea.

nodes.label: Wildlife biologist
nodes.note: Study and protect animals in the wild.

nodes.label: Dietitian or nutritionist
nodes.note: Plan healthy food for people.

nodes.label: Biology teacher
nodes.note: Teach biology in school or college.

nodes.label: Wildlife veterinarian
nodes.note: Treat animals in forests and zoos.

nodes.label: Livestock veterinarian
nodes.note: Care for farm animals and dairy.
